title: KALAVE 6 Pack Kitchen Funnel Set - Food Grade Silicone Collapsible Funnel, Funnels for Kitchen Use Filling Bottles, Daily Cooking, and Water or Powder Transfer. (Multicolor)
description:
About this item
【Food Grade Kitchen Funnel Set】KALAVE Kitchen funnel is made of premium food-Grade silicone, 100% BPA-free, thicker and more durable, ensuring superior stain and odor resistance. The silicone funnel can resist temperatures from -40°F to 440°F, is very safe for your families.
【Varied Sizes and Colors】The 3 sizes collapsible funnel set includes 6 funnels: 2 large, 2 medium, and 2 small, in red, orange, blue or green. Different sizes funnels for kitchen use filling bottles can meet your various needs, and different colors help you distinguish their uses, making your daily cooking and life more convenient.
【Space-efficient & Easy to Store】These collapsible kitchen funnels are designed for space efficiency and easy compression, occupying minimal space. They can be hung on the wall for convenient retrieval or tucked away in a drawer for neat storage. Compared to traditional metal and plastic funnels, they offer an 80% space-saving advantage.
【Easy to Clean & Dishwasher Safe】This kitchen funnel features a smooth, one-piece design that not only facilitates the seamless transfer of liquids and dry ingredients but is also extremely easy to clean and dry. Simply wash it with warm water and some soap, or place it in the dishwasher for cleaning.
【Customer Satisfaction】KALAVE is proud of its product quality and is committed to ensuring customers' purchasing experience and service by providing best services.If you are dissatisfied with this collapsible funnel at any point during its use, please contact us immediately, and we will try our best to make things right.
